files.summary: separate accepted special-authority policy from missing runtime delivery
edits: Existing player/NPC origin defaults remain unchanged. An NPC cannot grant itself a new lock exception. Player-delegated model/NPC work retains player origin. The [governance contract](../archive/03-design-proposals/invention-governance-and-ownership.md#special-player-invention-permission) already accepts creator administration and a scoped special-player grant for reviewed shared-law changes independently of ordinary invention locks. [INV-1.7](maintainers/inventions-and-world-evolution.md#accepted-foundation-decisions-and-remaining-branch-integration) and [MP02](maintainers/multiplayer.md) still own its missing admission/persistence implementation. This accepted target is not an available runtime bypass, an NPC exception, or authority over another human's private data, saves or spending. Administrative control of a lock remains distinct from permission to author while it is set.
